---
title: "Inversiones"
---

```{=html}

<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Inversiones financieras</h1><div class="tf-muted">Capital, plazo, tasa, rendimiento esperado/real, vencimiento y renovación.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div>
<div class="tf-grid tf-grid-2"><section class="tf-card"><h2>Calculadora / nueva inversión</h2><form id="inv-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Banco / institución</label><input id="inv-bank" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Nombre / certificado</label><input id="inv-name" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Capital ($)</label><input id="inv-principal" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="10000"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Tasa anual (%)</label><input id="inv-rate" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="5.5"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo de tasa</label><select id="inv-rate-type"><option value="nominal">Nominal</option><option value="effective">Efectiva</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cálculo</label><select id="inv-calc"><option value="simple">Interés simple</option><option value="compound">Capitalización</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Capitalización</label><select id="inv-cap"><option value="monthly">Mensual</option><option value="quarterly">Trimestral</option><option value="semiannual">Semestral</option><option value="annual">Anual</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Inicio</label><input id="inv-start" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Plazo</label><input id="inv-term" type="number" min="1" value="180"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Unidad</label><select id="inv-unit"><option value="days">Días</option><option value="months">Meses</option><option value="years">Años</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Retenciones ($)</label><input id="inv-withholding" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Comisiones ($)</label><input id="inv-fees" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta origen</label><select id="inv-account"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label class="tf-check"><input id="inv-already-moved" type="checkbox"> El movimiento de capital ya fue registrado</label><small>Marca solo si ya registraste manualmente la salida de capital.</small></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Recordar (días antes)</label><input id="inv-reminder" type="number" min="0" max="90" value="15"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions"><button id="inv-preview" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Calcular</button><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar inversión</button></div></form><div id="inv-preview-box" class="tf-subtle" style="margin-top:1rem"></div></section><section class="tf-card"><h2>Principio contable</h2><div class="tf-code">Capital invertido = transferencia de activo, no gasto.
Capital retornado = retorno de activo, no ingreso.
Solo el rendimiento neto = ingreso financiero.</div></section></div><div id="inv-list" class="tf-grid tf-grid-3" style="margin-top:1rem"></div>
<div class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem">
  <h2>Liquidar inversión</h2>
  <form id="inv-settle-form" class="tf-form-grid">
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Inversión</label><select id="settle-investment"></select></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta destino</label><select id="settle-account"></select></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="settle-date" type="date"></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Capital retornado ($)</label><input id="settle-principal" type="number" min="0" step="0.01"></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Rendimiento neto real ($)</label><input id="settle-interest" type="number" min="0" step="0.01"></div>
    <div class="tf-span-2"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Liquidar</button></div>
  </form>
</div>


<script type="module" src="js/investments.js"></script>
```
